description: Single filer; one W-2 ($50,000 wages, $4,000 withheld); one 1099-INT (Box 1 $500); one 1099-DIV (Box 1a $1,000, Box 1b $600); one 1099-B (short-term proceeds $8,000 / basis $6,000; long-term proceeds $3,000 / basis $3,500; no adjustments reported). Money values below are integer cents.

_sources.1z: Total income from Form W-2 (only component here); Form 1040 line 1z
_sources.2a: No tax-exempt interest was reported (the only 1099-INT has no Box 8 amount); Form 1040 line 2a; 1099-INT Box 8
_sources.2b: 1099-INT Box 1 = $500, plus $0 entered directly; Form 1040 line 2b
_sources.3b: 1099-DIV Box 1a (total ordinary dividends) = $1,000, plus $0 entered directly; Form 1040 line 3b
_sources.7: Capital gain: net short-term $2,000 + net long-term -$500 = $1,500; Form 1040 line 7 (capital gain from Schedule D)
_sources.schd_net_short: 1099-B short-term: proceeds (Box 1d) $8,000 - basis (Box 1e) $6,000 + adjustment (Box 1g, none reported) $0 = $2,000; Form 8949 Part I -> Schedule D netting (internal key feeding a future Schedule D)
_sources.schd_net_long: 1099-B long-term: proceeds (Box 1d) $3,000 - basis (Box 1e) $3,500 + adjustment (Box 1g, none reported) $0 = -$500; Form 8949 Part II -> Schedule D netting (internal key feeding a future Schedule D)
_sources.11: AGI = line 9 (no adjustments in this case); Form 1040 line 11
_sources.12: TY2025 standard deduction, single: $15,750 - Rev. Proc. 2024-40 as adjusted by OBBBA (P.L. 119-21); params/2025.json
_sources.16: Bracket tax (v1 method, see KNOWN_LIMITS - QDCG worksheet not applied): 11925 x 10% + (37250-11925) x 12% = 1192.50 + 3039.00 = $4,231.50 - brackets per Rev. Proc. 2024-40
_sources.25d: W-2 Box 2 $4,000 + 1099-INT Box 4 $0 + 1099-DIV Box 4 $0 + 1099-B Box 4 $0; Form 1040 line 25d
_sources.33: Line 33 = line 25d in v1 (withholding only, no refundable credits); Form 1040 line 33
_sources.34: No overpayment: line 33 ($4,000) does not exceed line 16 ($4,231.50); Form 1040 line 34
_sources.37: Line 16 - line 33 = 4231.50 - 4000 = $231.50 amount owed; Form 1040 line 37
